findings.title: Outcome consistency gate accepts applied resource reports that violate the frozen numeric contract
findings.expected: Freeze lines 35-44 and SPEC0294R2 section 4.3 require positive safe integer limits, swap=0, nonnegative safe integer or reasoned-null counters, closed seccomp profile IDs, and coherent reports checked before exit projection.
findings.observed: The namespace-observed branch returns solely on independence/executor and skips resources/seccomp validation. The guardian branch validates limits but skips events/peaks counter shape and numeric constraints and seccomp.profileId. validProcessResourceLimits and processCounter enforce some rules only when explicitly called; arbitrary typed ProcessOutcome values need not use those constructors.
static_counterexamples: Starting from the coherent A outcome in par-x03-adapter.test.ts:21, replace only containment.resources with a complete applied cgroup-v2 resource block whose pidsMax limit is -1 (all other limits/counters valid), retaining namespace-observed/owner/false and exact mirrors. These are representable TypeScript number fields. containment.ts:199-203 returns true without examining limits. With cause exit/exitCode 0/clean cleanup, run.ts:175 returns 0.

Starting from guardian() in par-x03-contracts.test.ts:53, retain valid limits and set resources.events.oomKill={value:-1,reason:null}, or {value:null,reason:null}, or seccomp.profileId to a value outside the closed union via the same seam used for invalid outcomes. None is checked at containment.ts:204-215; the shape is accepted.
findings.impact: A faulty report can be surfaced as successful with invalid applied-limit/counter diagnostics instead of being rejected as incoherent. This is a current S1 contract/adapter validation defect, not evidence that current service launches B: service.ts:158-159 still refuses every valid explicit B request and the real A producer emits not_required.
findings.remediation: Validate each present resource/seccomp variant and its closed reasons, limits, counters and profileId in the consistency gate, including the A variant that permits resource reports. Preserve legitimate unknown/not_required states as specified. This gate remains structural validation, never native proof authentication.
findings.closure: Pure/seam tests should feed invalid applied numeric fields and malformed counters/profile IDs through verifiedProcessOutcome and runContained, assert false/spawn_failed and unchanged cause, and retain coherent A behavior. No helper, launcher, payload or native B execution is required.

findings.title: A close failure can escape the read-only diagnostic as a raw exception
findings.expected: Freeze lines 75-78 specify closed public check/reason output, no raw errors, and refusal on uncertain reads; abort is the intentional cancellation exception.
findings.observed: small catches open/read errors, but closeSync in finally is unguarded. A close error overrides either the successful read or the caught read failure. Calls for /proc/self/cgroup, rootEmpty and controllers have no enclosing conversion to a closed refused report. The fixture closeSync never throws.
findings.impact: Rare read/descriptor cleanup failure rejects inspectProcessDelegation with the raw fs exception instead of a sanitized refused diagnostic. It fails closed and cannot yield candidate or qualify B; no actual close error was induced in this review.
findings.remediation: Handle close failure explicitly and make that read uncertain/refused, while preserving AbortSignal cancellation. Add one pure filesystem-seam close-failure case.
findings.closure: A mocked closeSync failure produces a closed refused report without raw exception content; ordinary read errors and abort remain correct. No host cgroup effects.

Observed/version/cleanup/mirror failures return spawn_failed with original cause via run.ts:149-169, but accepted reports can violate numeric/closed-value invariants. No runtime behavior certified.
